name: AI SEO Link Advisor
description: Analyzes an internal URL for SEO metrics and returns AI-generated, per-issue recommendations using the drupal/ai provider abstraction.
project_description:
AI SEO Link Advisor lets a permitted user submit an internal site URL and get an SEO report of that page combined with AI-generated recommendations. It integrates with the drupal/ai contributed module and uses whichever chat provider/model is configured as the site default.

The module exposes one form at /ai-seo-link-advisor-form (permission: access seo analyzer). On submit it validates the URL (valid format, http/https only, host must match the site's trusted_host_patterns, path must resolve to a routable non-admin Drupal page the current user may access), fetches that page over HTTP with a Guzzle client (redirects disabled), and runs a battery of SEO metrics against the parsed HTML. Metrics are organized under src/Analyzer (a Page + Parser + Metric/MetricFactory pipeline) covering meta tags, heading structure, content-to-code ratio, image alt text, URL length, SSL, redirects, content size, page load time, and the presence of robots.txt and sitemap.xml. Keyword-density and keyword-position metrics (title, description, headers, URL, path) also exist for keyword-based analysis. Stopword lists are bundled for English, Dutch, and Polish.

For each metric with a negative impact, the AiSeoLinkAdvisor service builds a prompt from the metric's analysis plus the offending value and asks the AI provider's chat operation for a concrete SEO fix, using a built-in SEO-expert system prompt. Results render as two collapsible tables (content analytics and general analytics) via the module's own theme hooks and Twig templates, with status icons (checked/warning/action). The form output is returned through an AJAX callback. There is no stored configuration entity; the AI provider/model comes from the AI module's site-wide chat default, and the trusted_host_patterns gate comes from settings.php. Requires drupal/ai 1.0+ with at least one chat provider installed and configured.
